prep: no prep/ directory and no prep.done for this slug; plan and audits built by the writer

inherited.M01: LRS2 and LRS3 overt read/broadcast speech video with paired audio; training augmentation (crops, flips, NOISEX babble, speed perturbation) from the authors' earlier recipes
inherited.M02: Character transcripts as supervision (hybrid CTC/attention lineage of Watanabe et al. and Petridis et al. 2018)
inherited.M03: Single training run per configuration; optional LRW front-end initialisation; alpha not stated
inherited.M04: Overt speech video with or without additive babble noise at test
inherited.M05: Grayscale 88x88 mouth crop from 68-landmark alignment and 16 kHz raw waveform
inherited.M11: LRS2 and LRS3 (v0.4 and v0.0) original splits and transcripts
inherited.M13: Front-end parameter counts only; no runtime

topics.inclusion_rule: Studies that decode sentence-level or open-vocabulary speech from lip or face video, alone or with audio (the 633-study population of M06/sentence-lipreading-sequence-objective), classified by the temporal encoder their full text names: Conformer, Transformer encoder, recurrent (LSTM/GRU), or temporal convolution (TCN/TDNN). Boundary: a study counts under every encoder its text names, including related-work mentions (upper bound); audio-only ASR is out of scope; versions count once by key.
topics.design_field: full-text regexes conformer, transformer_encoder, recurrent_encoder, temporal_convolution
topics.metric: LRS3 / LRS2 visual-only and audio-visual WER

topics.inclusion_rule: Studies whose ledger names audio-visual speech recognition (AVSR), classified by the audio-stream input their full text names: raw waveform fed to a learned front-end, or hand-designed spectral features (log-Mel filterbank, MFCC, spectrogram). Boundary: a study counts under every representation its text names (upper bound); visual-only lip reading without an audio stream is out; audio-visual speech enhancement without recognition is out unless the ledger names AVSR; versions count once by key.
topics.metric: LRS2 / LRS3 audio-only and audio-visual WER, clean and babble noise

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table (same 633-study sentence lip-reading population), classified by use-time language information: n-gram LM, neural LM or LLM rescoring, explicit no external LM.
topics.metric: LRS3 visual-only WER with and without external LM

topics.inclusion_rule: The same 349-study AVSR population as M06/avsr-audio-stream-input-representation, classified by evaluation protocol its full text names: additive-noise test at stated SNRs, babble noise in particular, and run-to-run variability (seeds, repeated runs, standard deviation, confidence intervals). Boundary: a study counts under every protocol its text names (upper bound, related-work mentions included); versions count once by key.
topics.metric: presence of the protocol; LRS3 AVSR WER for the state of the art
